entities.summary: Vassiliki Kalogera is a Greek astrophysicist. She is the Daniel I. Linzer Distinguished University Professor at Northwestern University, the director of the Center for Interdisciplinary Exploration and Research in Astrophysics (CIERA), and the founding director of the NSF-Simons AI Institute for the Sky. She is a leading member of the LIGO Collaboration that observed gravitational waves in 2015.
